दृह् दृह् (connected with rt. दृंह्), cl.
1. P. दर्हति, दृंहति, ददर्ह, दर्-
हिष्यति, दर्हितुम्, to fix, fasten, make firm or
strong, make immovable; (A.) to be fixed or fastened;
to be firm; to grow, increase, prosper: Caus. दृं-
हयति, &c., to make firm, to fix; to keep, hold
fast; to become fixed or strong, be firm.
दृहित or दृंहित, अस्, आ, अम्, grown, increased.
